Description

When using hand tracking for chat box it counts 1 press for 2 characters (ex. when you type 'h' you would get "hh") and its been going on for a while now. With numerous players qouting the same issue using hand tracking for chat box. I looked up what could be causing this or how to stop it from double clicking a keyboard character. I looked it up and apparently it's being cause by the interface counting the pinch down for 1 press then counting when you release the pinch as another press. Which I'm pretty sure yall already know since yall are the bug fixers and most likely already trying to fix it. After many of my online friends told me the same issue I wanted to see for my self so I did an experiment with my headset. And for a fact it was double clicking characters, thus made me do some digging and all I got was to make sure everthing is up to date, change some settings, and restart the program. I did all of these options and nothing worked. Which started to make me think if there is a communication error between oculus new hand tracking update and vrchat hand tracking interface or systems. Oddly enough the handtracking dosen't bug out as much when sginning in just when you are in a world its really bad. Yet all the conrols work perfectly fine with no issue or double clicking. Thank your for reading this small report and taking your time to help fix these bugs.

Reproduction Steps

When you start to type 1 keyboard character in the chat box using Hand Tracking it will count that one press as two presses. For its counting the pinch down as 1 press and when you release the pinch or un-pinch as another. (ex. press the letter "h" in the chat box using hand tracking, then you would get "hh" as the result)

- Frequency: Always
